prompts.serpent: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art animation spritesheet for a nautical game. Generate one transparent PNG containing exactly FOUR registered animation frames in a precise 2 by 2 grid with equal cells, no gutters or labels. Each cell represents a 64x56 logical-pixel canvas enlarged nearest-neighbor; output approximately 1024x896. Subject: one mysterious teal sea serpent with a long curved neck, small crested reptilian head facing right, amber eye, and two low coils trailing left at the water surface. Side view, matching classic 16-bit wooden pirate-ship pixel art. The waterline stays at logical row 46 in ALL frames, head occupies x=34..54 y=9..30, coils x=7..43. Four quiet surfacing poses: head low, raised slightly, watching, settling. Keep scale/identity/waterline registered. Creature silhouette fits inside every cell with 3 logical pixels clear margin; a few small pale foam strokes along its base only, NO rectangular ocean/background. Pixel clusters and hard stepped edges, disciplined flat shading, not rendered 3D, no blur or glow or antialias. Restrict colours to navy #151E2D #1D314E, teal #2C4869 #45617A #64849A #8FA8B4, pale foam #BECAC6 #D9D4BE, tiny amber #C38B4D. Creature should read at 64x56. True transparent background; no text, grid lines, panel frames, watermark, unrelated objects. This is original game art.
prompts.kraken: Use case: stylized-concept. Original production pixel-art sprite sheet for a wooden pirate-ship game. Exactly four animation frames in a regular 2x2 grid with equal cells; each cell 48x56 logical pixels enlarged nearest neighbor, final sheet about 960x1120. True transparent background, no grid, labels or text. Subject: one deep-sea kraken's two curling tentacles breaking the surface, a tall elegant hook facing left and one short companion curl, not a whole octopus. View from side with slight top visibility to match a side-on wooden ship. Quiet ominous presence, no violence. Navy outline #151E2D #1D314E, dusky teal body #2C4869 #45617A #64849A, pale underside/suckers #8FA8B4 #BECAC6; small foam flecks #D9D4BE at base. Clear silhouette, chunky hard-edged 16-bit pixel clusters, restrained shading; no gradients, blur, glow, shadows or background ocean. Four poses of a slow sway, same thickness and size, base waterline always row 49 and x center 24, tip around row 7. All visible art inside 3-pixel clear borders. Frame 1 tips lean left; frame 2 rise; frame 3 gently curl inward; frame 4 settle. Keep the feet/base registered and individual suckers readable at small scale. No ship, no human, no unrelated items.
prompts.lightning: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 16-bit pixel art VFX sprite sheet for distant thunder/lightning over a pirate ship. True transparent background. Exactly TWO equal 32x48 logical-pixel frames side by side enlarged as hard pixels to about 1024x768. Each frame top endpoint registered at x=16,y=4, bottom no lower than row44, clear 2 pixel border. First frame a bold crooked lightning fork descending from the top center with 2 short branching forks, pale ivory 2-3 pixel core (#D9D4BE), steel blue edge (#8FA8B4), muted blue remnants (#64849A); second frame SAME registered crooked fork with broken and dimmer residual branches. The main silhouette must remain readable at original 32x48 and 50% opacity. Lightning drawn as angular connected chunky pixel clusters, not soft glow. No cloud, no rain, no sea, no background fill, no full-screen flash. No extra bolt objects, text, labels, frame borders, grid, gradient, antialias or watermark. Classic restrained nautical pixel-art palette only #45617A #64849A #8FA8B4 #BECAC6 #D9D4BE. Keep each bolt entirely within its frame.
